title: The Moth That Was Many
story: Deep in the moonlit granary loft, Vaultmoth the Splitting Silkwing eats grain sacks — and every swat of a broom splits her into more moths. The farmers have already swung three times and things are getting worse. Mr 6 puts a hand on the broom and says, "Let us think before we swing again."
question: Vaultmoth started as 1 moth, and each swat triples the number of moths. The farmers have already swatted 3 times. If Mr 6 lets them swat exactly 2 more times before his freezing-lantern traps them all, how many moths will be in the loft?
hint: Start at 1 and triple it once for every swat — count all five swats.
victory: Two hundred forty-three moths flew straight into Mr 6's cold blue lantern-light and settled down for a nap; the grain was saved, and the farmers hung up their brooms.
imagePrompt: A moonlit wooden granary loft swirling with hundreds of pale silver moths as a small numeral-six knight raises a glowing blue lantern, farmers frozen mid-broom-swing behind him.
